NVIDIA Reflex: frame pacing markers and low-latency sleep to reduce input latency.
vulkanforge.config.nvidia.device_diagnos: Inserts checkpoints in command buffers to locate the failing command after a GPU crash (device lost).
Enables NVIDIA Aftermath crash dump details (shader debug info, resource tracking). Has a performance cost.

vulkanforge.config.nvidia.device_generat: Lets the GPU build draw commands itself, a candidate for GPU culling of chunk sections.
vulkanforge.config.nvidia.representative: Skips redundant fragments in occlusion-query style passes.
vulkanforge.config.nvidia.shading_rate_i: Variable-rate shading driven by an image; lowers shading cost in less important screen regions.

vulkanforge.config.plan.interleaved.tool: Keeps the original GL/VK interleaving and Vulkan swapchain presentation for fallback and comparison. Requires restart.
vulkanforge.config.mode.gl.tooltip: OpenGL rendering, GL 4.3–4.6 compatibility and performance.
